interfaces.reply_policy: Only current request id accepted; dirty data not overwritten by reload; busy blocks repeat writes/leave; modal new-record dialog busy and selection rechecked
interfaces.catalogReady_limit: Standalone readonly choices only; ProjectRecords contains base/results subset and must never be republished as complete advanced project configuration
interfaces.thread_ownership: Create store without parent; move to SQL QThread; initialize/use/close both database connections there; values via queued signals; close then quit/wait then deleteLater

data_contract.catalog_access: Separate QSQLITE_OPEN_READONLY connection; marker sn100-catalog-offline-v1; no direct shared table writes
data_contract.ids: Local INTEGER AUTOINCREMENT record id and optimistic revision; projectId=project_base.id, batchId=reagent_batch_group.id; never instrument calibration_total_count/id
data_contract.time: createdAt immutable UTC ISO milliseconds; changedAt updated on successful point save only; UI original date format in OS local time, UTC timestamp tooltip
data_contract.axes: x=explicit concentration in saved concentrationUnit; y=arithmetic mean of repeated Original values in saved resultUnit; no transform, fit, interpolation, inverse or clinical result
data_contract.unit_ratio: Committed catalog snapshot provenance only; values are already in explicitly displayed unit, no silent multiply/divide or later unit reinterpretation
data_contract.points: 1..32 ordered contiguous 1-based points; each 1..8 equal repeat count; explicit nonempty sampleRate label <=64; no dilution calculation; finite numbers0..99999, <=4 decimals; duplicate concentration rejected; descending order preserved; duplicate test values and explicit zero allowed
data_contract.empty_and_invalid: Empty record cannot save; blank/invalid editor values clear stale raw plot/means and keep draft; no fabricated initial values
data_contract.copy: Copy committed visible source at matching revision to new local id/sourceId; dirty copy disabled; always unreviewed/unapplied
data_contract.delete: Revision-checked visible=0 soft delete, original points retained; not a catalog batch or project deletion
data_contract.durability: Bound parameters, local transaction header+all points, rollback on failure, synchronous FULL, bounded SQLite busy wait250ms in worker
data_contract.bounds: Visible records2048, catalog projects1024, batches4096; capacity errors explicit; no unbounded write retry
data_contract.not_imported: No original production DB, patient data, task waveform, flagged measurement/error/task-id import or production calibration ID mapping

reference_protection.implemented: Fresh readonly lookup rejects missing/renamed/disabled project, missing/changed units or ratio, missing/reassigned/recoded/regrouped batch. Saved identity immutable; historic labels/points readable even if catalog later changes/deletes. No silent reassociation.
reference_protection.not_claimed: This readonly independent client does not prevent a later separate catalog write and has no cross-DB FK/atomic transaction; persistent reservation protocol remains an integration gate.
reference_protection.must_do_before_unified_writes: Coordinator must reserve project+batch with owner APIs, await both successes, then fresh catalog validation and local commit, persist durable reference keys/outcome. Current Page calls Store directly: attaching menu alone is insufficient. Until coordinator tested, give calibration page/store a copy of session.actionReady=false while other modules retain their own session.
reference_protection.hidden_and_crash: Soft-hidden rows retain history; keep holds. Reconciliation must include hidden rows via a new worker API; current public load only returns visible. Unknown/crash outcomes preserve holds until explicit reconciliation; never release automatically at startup.
reference_protection.failure: Only release holds acquired by that save after confirmed local noncommit; do not release prior records or unknown state. See integration_review.json.
